goal: Prove opt-in Rust cuda-oxide plain and weighted RMS normalization kernels against current-C row-reduction semantics without claiming fused normalization, projection, Q8, or runtime-route ownership.

cuda_oxide.module_form: executable-local #[cuda_module] with libdevice-linked reciprocal RMS scaling

covered_behavior: rms_norm_plain_kernel 256-thread row reduction and reciprocal RMS scaling
rms_norm_weight_kernel 256-thread row reduction followed by elementwise weights
excluded_behavior: fused QKV RMS normalization and head normalization kernels
dense projection and Q8 conversion or matmul kernels
runtime graph integration and default CUDA route

rust_owned_in_this_stage: plain and weighted row-wise RMS normalization tensor validation
not_claimed_in_this_stage: fused QKV or head RMS normalization kernels
dense projection or Q8 conversion and matmul kernels
runtime graph integration or default CUDA route

b300_execution.command: CARGO_HOME=/tmp/cargo RUSTUP_HOME=/tmp/rustup PATH=/tmp/cargo/bin:$PATH LIBCLANG_PATH=/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.2 RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly-2026-04-03 CUDA_OXIDE_BACKEND=/workspace/cuda-oxide/crates/rustc-codegen-cuda/target/debug/librustc_codegen_cuda.so CUDA_OXIDE_LLC=/usr/bin/llc CUDA_OXIDE_VERBOSE=1 cargo run --manifest-path /workspace/cuda-oxide/crates/cargo-oxide/Cargo.toml -- run --features cuda-oxide-kernels --bin ds4-cuda-rms-norm-smoke
